Q0267

John Stuart Mill

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / John Stuart Mill / Q0267

English

The only purpose for which power can be rightfully exercised over any member of a civilized community, against his will, is to prevent harm to others.
Thinker John Stuart Mill
School Liberalism
Source On Liberty I
Theme Liberty
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with On Liberty I, within the tradition of Liberalism. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of liberty, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In John Stuart Mill's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
